comment: Pairs (photo, word) judged present (yes) or absent (no) by eye on 512 px copies, for the ai_tags probe. Photos: the 120 of corpus.json and every fourth photo of each day of calibration.json. Judged by Claude subagents on 2026-11-13 with written rules (doubt counts as no); reviewable by anyone with the ai-dev folder. A third pass judged the pairs the softmax selection adds (probability 0.02, six words). Gender words (man, woman, 1girl, 1boy) judged in a second pass the same day. A fourth pass (2026-11-13, learned head) judged the pairs of the widest selection of the head and zero-shot words (minimum 0.02, twelve tags), doubt counted as no. Tuning generated images (tuning-generated/, ai-dev tags-tuning/generated/manifest.json, Wikimedia Commons, another seed and none of the test titles) added the same day, their pairs judged like the others.
